description: What the Rust FX execution path demonstrably supports for each Easy-LLM provider adapter. Descriptive evidence derived from conformance/ results, not a runtime contract: FX request validation, SingleAttemptCapability and the executor stay authoritative.

evidence.note: Every status is established against a local mock of the provider wire format, through the real adapter and the real Rust executor. None was established against a live provider.

usage_stream.note: The adapter parses a usage chunk when the provider sends one, but its request does not ask for streamed usage (no stream_options). Whether a live provider sends it through this path is not established.

late_events_ignored.note: The adapter reads to the end of input before yielding its terminal event, so text sent after the provider's own terminal marker joins the output.

malformed_chunks_reported.note: The client skips a stream line it cannot parse. Text carried only by such a line is lost without any signal; the attempt can still complete with verified evidence.

tool_definitions.note: Refused before dispatch (capability_unavailable, definitely_unsent): the FX path cannot offer a provider any tool. The adapters send tool names with empty schemas, which is not tool-definition support.

tool_call_history.note: Refused before dispatch: assistant tool calls and tool results cannot be replayed through this path.

images.note: Refused before dispatch: the FX path carries text only.

generation_options.note: Refused before dispatch: no generation option is transported (the adapters send fixed values).

structured_output.note: Refused before dispatch: response formats cannot be requested.

text_stream.note: The adapter yields its terminal event unconditionally at end of input and never reads the finish reason, so a streamed attempt can never present verified completion: it always ends interrupted with its partial output. The stream wire format (one JSON object per line) is also assumed, not checked against the live service.

finish_reason_stream.note: No finish reason or other terminal evidence is carried from a Google stream.

usage_stream.note: A Google stream never completes, so no completed attempt carries usage.

late_events_ignored.note: The stream has no terminal marker, so there is no point after which output counts as late.
